meta.title: Signs of Winter — Vocabulary Set 4
meta.subject: English Vocabulary
meta.description: Sentence completion practice using all 16 target words from 'Signs of Winter'.

questions.question: Many wild animals grow thick _______ to keep warm in the cold winter.
questions.explanation: Thick fur keeps animals warm by trapping body heat during winter.

questions.question: In winter, there is very little daylight, so it gets dark early.
questions.explanation: True. Shorter days in winter mean we experience less daylight.

questions.question: Vanessa and Tom roll a huge snowball to build a _______.
questions.explanation: A snowman is a figure made by stacking large snowballs.

questions.question: We use a sled to slide down snowy hills in the winter.
questions.explanation: True. Sleds are vehicles designed to slide on snow.

questions.question: Winter is the coldest _______ of the year.
questions.explanation: Winter is one of the four seasons, and it brings the coldest weather of the year.

questions.question: We check the _______ report to see if it will snow tomorrow.
questions.hint: What it is like outside (clouds, rain, snow).
questions.explanation: A weather report tells us about atmospheric conditions like snow, rain, or sun.

questions.question: During the year, Earth will _______ around the sun.
questions.explanation: To travel means to move from place to place; Earth travels (orbits) around the sun.

questions.question: Sort these sentences based on whether they describe Nature/Climate or human/animal Actions:
questions.explanation: Daylight changes and temperature drops are natural events. Collecting, building, and sledding are actions.

questions.question: Evergreen needles stay on pine branches even during winter.
questions.explanation: True. Evergreen trees like pine and fir keep their needles (leaves) all winter long.

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe winter weather:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'The temperature is very cold.' Temperature measures heat.

questions.question: Beavers _______ extra logs in autumn to eat during winter.
questions.explanation: To collect means to gather items together, which is what beavers do with branches.

questions.question: Many tree branches are _______ in winter because they lose their leaves.
questions.explanation: Bare branches are empty branches that do not have leaves.

questions.question: Arrange the words to show where beavers live:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'Beavers live in a lodge.' A lodge is their water home.

questions.question: A change in weather means the weather stays exactly the same.
questions.explanation: False. A change in weather means it becomes different (for example, from warm to cold).

questions.question: If you pack _______ clothes, you have packed more clothes than you usually need.
questions.explanation: Extra means additional or more than what is normal or required.
